about: Default screening distances by asset type and size (DRAFT, 18 Nov 2026, for Rob to correct). Distances in km from the footprint edge: near, close, wider (the run fetches out to 'wider' once; the card's slider works inside it). 'footprint_km' is the radius used when the site is only a point. Rules in 'larger' apply when the stated size is at least the threshold; the last matching rule wins. Reasons are shown to the person beside the distances.

onshore.reason: construction and glint near, traffic and views close, protected sites wider

smaller.reason: small array (under 5 MW): construction effects stay local

larger.reason: large array (100 MW or more): bigger land take and longer construction

onshore.reason: noise and shadow flicker near, visual and birds close, protected sites wider

tip_height.reason: near band = 10 times the tip height (shadow flicker and noise), at least 1 km

larger.reason: large wind farm (100 MW or more): wider visual and bird context

larger.reason: very large offshore wind (1 GW or more): seabird foraging ranges reach further

noise and safety near, air quality and traffic close, protected sites wider

blasting and dust near, water and influx close, catchment and protected sites wider
